Thanks Giving:  A Practice

Thanks giving is giving Thanks.

It spreads the formless essence of gratitude

into actual sounds of heartfelt expression.

It is a journey from energy to thought to word.

And, the opportunity awaits us in every moment.

Looking for it, sharing it,

this offering of peace and love

unto our self, others

and everything on the earth.

Seeing how it feels,

noticing the effect.

So many ways, so many teachers

finding each our own . . .

Then feeding it to the hungry

offering it to the poor

speaking it generously unto the all

and creating an outward expression of an inner magic.

 

A Practice:  Giving Thanks

Did you give your thanks today?

Poem by Ken and Pam Blue
